daily.today_energy: Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo is firing you up with extra confidence, but Saturn retrograde in your sign is asking you to pause and check your motivations first. It's a good day to channel that bold energy into something that actually matters.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is bringing warmth to your connections, but with the Moon in Pisces, people might need more emotional reassurance than usual. Show up with both your fire and your tenderness—it's a solid combo right now.
daily.career: The Sun square Mars tension is real, but it's not a roadblock—it's pushing you to be more strategic. Don't just react; take a beat before you make moves. Your ambition is there, just pair it with a little planning today.
daily.health: All this Mars-Jupiter activation has you wanting to move, which is great. Just make sure you're not running on pure adrenaline. Fuel up properly and listen if your body's asking for rest between the intense bursts.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to slow down and listen to what your intuition's been trying to tell you. Mercury's vibes suggest clarity is coming, but only if you're willing to sit with the discomfort first. Trust the process.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, this is about authenticity over performance. Someone might be trying to get your attention, but the real invitation is to show up as your actual self. No cap, that's the move.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is peaking, even if it doesn't feel like it yet. This is the week to pitch that idea you've been workshopping or take on a project that actually excites you. Small momentum builds into something real.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding this week—whether that's walks, stretching, or just being more present in your day. Energy levels might feel scattered, so lean into what makes you feel centered and whole.
